features.name: recent_heavy_rainfall_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator for significant recent rainfall (over 0.5 inches in the last 3 days), which tree models can use as a primary split for runoff events.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clean, binary threshold for tree models to isolate high-runoff conditions that often transport contaminants.

features.name: livestock_proximity_risk
features.description: Binary feature indicating the presence of livestock within a close proximity (less than 2 units distance).
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows tree models to immediately partition samples where direct agricultural animal runoff is highly probable.

features.name: water_temp_do_interaction
features.description: Ratio of water temperature to dissolved oxygen, capturing conditions of warm, stagnant water.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a nonlinear interaction feature that highlights environments conducive to bacterial survival, saving the tree from having to approximate this ratio through multiple splits.

features.name: human_source_pollution_risk
features.description: Interaction between septic density and proximity to wastewater infrastructure, amplifying the risk score when wastewater is nearby.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two human-derived pollution metrics into a single continuous risk gradient for efficient tree splitting.

features.name: turbidity_flow_index
features.description: Product of turbidity and flow, representing the total volume of suspended solids moving through the system.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct measure of active sediment transport, which is strongly correlated with particle-bound contaminants.

features.name: solar_temp_growth_potential
features.description: Product of 10-day average temperature and 10-day average solar radiation, estimating the recent energy available for biological growth.
features.expected_model_benefit: Synthesizes long-term weather patterns into a single growth-conducive index, reducing the depth required for the tree to model weather interactions.

features.name: agricultural_runoff_potential
features.description: Semantic assessment of the likelihood of agricultural runoff reaching the waterbody, based on the interplay between pasture/crop land cover (idw_X81, idw_X82), soil types, and recent precipitation patterns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures complex, multi-variable spatial relationships that are difficult to express in simple arithmetic formulas, providing a high-level risk bucket for the model.

features.name: urban_runoff_impact
features.description: Impervious cover weighted by the proximity to stormwater outfalls, doubling the impact score if outfalls are very close.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights urbanized areas with direct drainage pathways, allowing the tree to easily separate urban-driven contamination events.

features.name: wetland_forest_buffer_protection
features.description: Ratio of protective land cover (forest/wetland) to developed land cover within the 60m buffer zone.
features.expected_model_benefit: Quantifies the natural filtration capacity of the immediate riparian zone, serving as a strong mitigating feature against runoff.

features.name: sustained_precipitation_ratio
features.description: Ratio of 5-day precipitation to 30-day precipitation, identifying sudden wet periods relative to the baseline.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes rainfall events against recent historical baselines, helping the model distinguish between chronic wetness and acute storm flushes.

features.name: bacterial_marker_presence
features.description: Logical OR (maximum) of human (HF183) and ruminant (Rum2Bac) specific bacterial marker presence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Consolidates sparse biological marker data into a single, highly predictive boolean flag for tree splits.

features.name: stagnation_risk_score
features.description: Semantic evaluation of water stagnation risk, integrating low flow, low dissolved oxygen, high temperatures, and physical channel characteristics like collapsed bottoms or ditch structures.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal scale of stagnation severity, grouping multiple physical and chemical indicators into a single monotonic feature ideal for tree thresholds.
